title.zh: 福康宁：14 世纪的港口

summary.en: On the hill above the river, digs since 1984 have found Chinese porcelain, glass, coins and workshop remains from a fourteenth-century port.
summary.zh: 河口北边的山上，1984 年以来的发掘出土了中国瓷器、玻璃、钱币和作坊遗迹，属于 14 世纪的一个港口。

detail.en: The archaeologist John Miksic led the first dig in January 1984. In 1928 workers found Javanese-style gold ornaments here. The marker stands at the centre of the hill, not at a particular trench.
detail.zh: 考古学家米克锡克 1984 年 1 月主持第一次发掘。1928 年，工人在这里挖到爪哇风格的金饰。标记放在山的中心，不是某一个探方的位置。

summary.en: A large inscribed rock at the river mouth, blown up by the British in 1843; a fragment is in the National Museum, its script unread.
summary.zh: 河口一块刻有文字的大石，1843 年被英国人炸毁；一块残片藏在国家博物馆，文字至今未能读通。

detail.en: An 1825 survey shows the rock on Rocky Point, at the mouth of the river near today's Fullerton building. Legend links it to the strongman Badang; the inscription itself has not been fully deciphered. The marker is approximate.
detail.zh: 1825 年的测绘图把它画在河口的岩角上，大约在今天浮尔顿大厦附近。传说它和大力士巴当有关；石上的文字至今没有完全读通。标记位置是近似的。

summary.en: A strait Wang Dayuan described in 1349; it is usually placed at the western entrance to Keppel Harbour, but scholars disagree.
summary.zh: 汪大渊 1349 年记下的一道海峡，一般认为在吉宝港西口，但学者看法不一。

detail.en: Wang Dayuan wrote of two rocks like dragon's teeth at the strait's mouth. Some scholars place Longyamen at the Keppel entrance, where a rock stood until 1848; others place it elsewhere in the Singapore Strait. The marker follows the usual identification; the replica rock at Labrador Park is not the original.
detail.zh: 汪大渊说海峡口有两块状如龙牙的石头。有学者认为龙牙门就在吉宝港入口，那里原有一块大石，1848 年被炸掉；也有人认为在新加坡海峡的别处。标记按通常的说法放置；拉柏多公园的石头是复制品。

summary.en: Around 1540 Sultan Alauddin Riayat Shah II built a fort and royal town here on the Johor River, one of the sultanate's many capitals.
summary.zh: 1540 年前后，苏丹阿拉乌丁·利亚特沙二世在柔佛河畔建起城堡和王城，这是柔佛苏丹国多个王都之一。

detail.en: After the Portuguese took Malacca in 1511, its royal family moved its capital several times between the Johor River and the Riau islands. The marker is at the present village of Johor Lama.
detail.zh: 1511 年葡萄牙人攻占马六甲以后，马六甲王室多次在柔佛河与廖内群岛之间迁都。标记放在今天的柔佛拉玛村。

summary.en: The small island off Bintan that became a seat of the Riau court; in 1803 it was given to Engku Puteri Hamidah as a wedding gift.
summary.zh: 民丹岛外的小岛，后来成为廖内朝廷的所在地；1803 年作为结婚礼物赠给恩古·布特丽·哈米达。

detail.en: Engku Puteri Hamidah, a wife of Sultan Mahmud III, kept the royal regalia after his death and would not hand them to Hussein. From Penyengat the Bugis-led court of Riau ruled the islands south of the Straits. The marker is the island, not a particular palace.
detail.zh: 恩古·布特丽·哈米达是苏丹马末沙三世的王后之一，苏丹死后她保管王室信物，不肯交给胡先。廖内朝廷由武吉斯贵族主导，以 Penyengat 岛为中心，统治海峡以南的群岛。标记是整座岛，不是某一座宫殿。

summary.en: In 1787 Sultan Mahmud III moved his court from Riau to Daik on Lingga island; he died there in 1812.
summary.zh: 1787 年，苏丹马末沙三世把王廷从廖内迁到林加岛的 Daik；1812 年他在这里去世。

detail.en: The move took the sultan away from the Bugis nobles and the Dutch at Riau. The marker is the town of Daik.
detail.zh: 这次迁都让苏丹远离廖内的武吉斯贵族和荷兰人。标记放在 Daik 镇。

summary.en: The East India Company took possession of Penang island on 11 August 1786, by agreement with the Sultan of Kedah; Malay villages were already there.
summary.zh: 1786 年 8 月 11 日，英国东印度公司按与吉打苏丹的协议接管槟城岛；岛上原本已有马来人村落。

detail.en: Penang was Britain's first base in the Straits. The marker is George Town.
detail.zh: 槟城是英国在海峡的第一个据点。标记放在乔治市。

summary.en: The great port of the fifteenth century, taken by the Portuguese in 1511 and the Dutch in 1641; held by the British in 1795–1818 and again from 1825.
summary.zh: 15 世纪的大港，1511 年被葡萄牙人攻占，1641 年归荷兰；1795 年至 1818 年由英国占领，1825 年起再归英国。

detail.en: When the British reached Singapore in 1819, Malacca had just been handed back to the Dutch. The marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 1819 年英国人来到新加坡时，马六甲刚刚交还荷兰。标记放在市中心。

summary.en: The ruler of Johor–Riau died at Lingga, on 14 January 1811 according to NLB (one study gives 1812), without a settled heir; factions at court backed different sons.
summary.zh: 柔佛—廖内的统治者在林加去世，据新加坡国家图书馆管理局是 1811 年 1 月 14 日（也有研究写 1812 年），继承人未定，朝中各派拥立不同的儿子。

detail.en: The Bugis viceroy at Lingga backed the younger son, Abdul Rahman; the elder son, Hussein (Tengku Long), was passed over. The royal regalia stayed with the late sultan's widow, Engku Puteri Hamidah. The British later used this dispute to make Hussein sultan. The marker is Daik, the sultan's seat on Lingga.
detail.zh: 林加的武吉斯副王拥立幼子阿都拉曼，长子胡先（东姑隆）被撇在一边。王室信物留在已故苏丹的遗孀恩古·布特丽·哈米达手里。后来英国人利用这场争执，立胡先为苏丹。标记放在林加岛上苏丹的驻地 Daik 。

title.zh: 东印度公司的船队到达

summary.en: On 28 January 1819 Raffles's ships anchored off St John's Island; he went ashore at the river mouth on the 28th or 29th (accounts differ).
summary.zh: 1819 年 1 月 28 日，莱佛士的船队停泊在圣约翰岛外；他在 28 日或 29 日登上河口（说法不一）。

detail.en: Raffles and Farquhar had sailed from Penang on 19 January and met at the Karimun islands on the 27th. The marker is the river-mouth landing site remembered today, behind Parliament House; where he actually stepped ashore is not known.
detail.zh: 莱佛士和法夸尔 1 月 19 日从槟城出发，27 日在卡里摩群岛会合。标记放在今天国会大厦后面纪念登陆的地点；他实际在哪里上岸并不清楚。

summary.en: On 30 January 1819 Temenggong Abdul Rahman agreed to let the Company set up a trading post, pending a treaty with a sultan.
summary.zh: 1819 年 1 月 30 日，天猛公阿都拉曼同意让东印度公司设立商站，正式条约待与苏丹签订。

detail.en: The Temenggong could not cede land on his own authority, so Raffles needed a sultan to sign. The marker is near the Temenggong's settlement on the north bank; where the agreement was signed is not known.
detail.zh: 天猛公无权独自割让土地，所以莱佛士需要一位苏丹签字。标记放在河北岸天猛公村落一带；协议在哪里签的并不清楚。

summary.en: Hussein, elder son of the late Sultan Mahmud, arrived in Singapore in early February 1819: on the 1st according to one account, the 5th according to another.
summary.zh: 已故苏丹马末的长子胡先 1819 年 2 月初到达新加坡：一说 1 日，一说 5 日。

detail.en: He had been living quietly in Riau after being passed over. Farquhar and the Temenggong's men brought him across the strait so that the British could recognise him as Sultan of Johor. The marker is Penyengat in Riau.
detail.zh: 失去王位之后，他一直在廖内过着平淡的日子。法夸尔和天猛公的人把他接过海峡，好让英国人承认他为柔佛苏丹。标记放在廖内的 Penyengat 岛。

title.zh: 1819 年 2 月 6 日的条约

summary.en: Raffles, Sultan Hussein and Temenggong Abdul Rahman signed a treaty letting the Company build a trading post, for yearly payments of 5,000 and 3,000 Spanish dollars.
summary.zh: 莱佛士、苏丹胡先和天猛公阿都拉曼签约，让东印度公司兴建商站，公司每年分别付给两人 5,000 和 3,000 西班牙银元。

detail.en: The treaty did not hand the island to Britain: it allowed a trading post on land around the river mouth. The Dutch and the Riau court did not recognise it. Where it was signed is not known; the marker is near the Temenggong's settlement.
detail.zh: 这份条约没有把整座岛交给英国，只准在河口一带的土地上设立商站。荷兰和廖内朝廷都不承认。签约地点不详，标记放在天猛公村落一带。

summary.en: Dutch officials in Malacca and Batavia protested that Singapore belonged to the sultan they recognised in Riau.
summary.zh: 马六甲和巴达维亚的荷兰官员抗议说，新加坡属于他们在廖内承认的那位苏丹。

detail.en: The British government in London and the Company's government in Calcutta also hesitated over keeping the settlement. The quarrel was settled by the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824. The marker is Malacca.
detail.zh: 伦敦的英国政府和加尔各答的公司政府，对是否保留这个商站也拿不定主意。这场争执到 1824 年的《英荷条约》才了结。标记放在马六甲。

summary.en: William Farquhar, formerly Resident of Malacca, was appointed to run the new settlement; Raffles sailed away on 7 February.
summary.zh: 前马六甲驻扎官法夸尔被任命管理新商站；莱佛士在 2 月 7 日离开。

detail.en: With little money from the Company, Farquhar let the town grow quickly and paid for it by licensing opium, spirits and gambling. Raffles later objected, and in 1823 removed him.
detail.zh: 公司拨款很少，法夸尔让城镇迅速发展，靠发放鸦片、酒和赌博的执照筹钱。莱佛士后来表示反对，1823 年把他撤换。

summary.en: Temenggong Abdul Rahman and his followers, among them Orang Laut, lived at the river mouth when the British came; he had moved here from Riau not long before.
summary.zh: 英国人来的时候，天猛公阿都拉曼和他的随从（其中有海人）住在河口；他是不久前才从廖内迁来的。

detail.en: A Dutch treaty with Johor in 1818 had cut his power and income in Riau. By 1824 his following numbered 6,000 to 10,000. He later moved to Telok Blangah. The marker is near the north bank; the village's extent is not known.
detail.zh: 1818 年荷兰与柔佛订约，削弱了他在廖内的权力和收入。到 1824 年，他的追随者有 6,000 至 10,000 人。他后来迁往直落布兰雅。标记放在河北岸一带，村落的范围不详。

summary.en: Raffles appointed a Town Committee in October 1822 and gave it written instructions on 4 November for laying out the town.
summary.zh: 莱佛士 1822 年 10 月成立城区委员会，11 月 4 日给委员会下达规划城区的书面指示。

detail.en: Lieutenant Philip Jackson drew the plan that followed. It gave each community a quarter of its own and reserved the hill and the plain north of the river for the government. The marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 随后杰克逊中尉画出规划图：每个族群各分一区，河北岸的小山和平地留给政府。标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: In 1822–23 a small hill was cut down and its earth used to fill the swamp on the south bank, where Boat Quay was built.
summary.zh: 1822 年至 1823 年，一座小山被削平，泥土用来填河南岸的沼泽，驳船码头就建在上面。

detail.en: It was Singapore's first land reclamation. The hill stood where Raffles Place is now. The marker is Boat Quay.
detail.zh: 这是新加坡第一次填土造地。被削平的小山就在今天莱佛士坊的位置。标记放在驳船码头。

title.zh: 1823 年 6 月 7 日的协议

summary.en: The Sultan and the Temenggong gave up their share of port dues and most of their powers in the settlement for allowances of $1,500 and $800 a month.
summary.zh: 苏丹和天猛公放弃港口税收的分成和在商站内的大部分权力，改领每月 1,500 元和 800 元的津贴。

detail.en: The British took over the courts and the land around the town. Where it was signed is not recorded; the marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 法院和城区周围的土地从此由英国人掌管。签约地点没有记载，标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: After the 1823 agreement the Temenggong moved his household and followers here, west of the town.
summary.zh: 1823 年的协议之后，天猛公带着家人和随从迁到城区以西的这里。

detail.en: His son Daeng Ibrahim and grandson Abu Bakar ruled from here before moving to Johor Bahru; Abu Bakar became Sultan of Johor. The marker is the district.
detail.zh: 他的儿子达因·依布拉欣和孙子阿布巴卡曾以这里为基地，后来迁往新山；阿布巴卡后来成为柔佛苏丹。标记放在这一地区。

summary.en: Sultan Hussein's first palace, of timber with attap roofs, was finished in 1819; the present Istana was built later, after his son Ali returned in 1840.
summary.zh: 苏丹胡先的第一座王宫用木头和亚答叶建成，1819 年完工；今天的皇宫是后来他的儿子阿里在 1840 年回来以后兴建的。

detail.en: The 1822 plan set aside the land between the river and the sea at Kampong Glam for the Sultan and his followers. The marker is the present Istana Kampong Glam.
detail.zh: 1822 年的规划把甘榜格南一带划给苏丹和他的随从。标记放在今天的甘榜格南皇宫。

title.en: Foundation stone of the Singapore Institution

summary.en: Raffles laid the foundation stone of a school on 5 June 1823; it opened years later and became Raffles Institution.
summary.zh: 1823 年 6 月 5 日，莱佛士为一所学校奠基；学校多年后才开课，后来成为莱佛士书院。

detail.en: Raffles wanted a college for the sons of local rulers and for the study of the region's languages. The marker is the old Bras Basah site, now Raffles City.
detail.zh: 莱佛士想办一所书院，让本地统治者的子弟读书，并研究本区域的语言。标记放在百胜路的旧址，今天的莱佛士城。

summary.en: Signed in London on 17 March 1824: Malacca went to Britain, Bencoolen to the Netherlands, and the two powers split the Malay world along the Straits.
summary.zh: 1824 年 3 月 17 日在伦敦签订：马六甲归英国，明古连归荷兰，两国以海峡为界瓜分马来世界。

detail.en: The Dutch dropped their objection to Singapore. No Malay ruler took part, though the treaty divided the Johor–Riau sultanate. The marker is placed in the Straits of Malacca, along the line the treaty drew; the treaty was signed in London.
detail.zh: 荷兰不再反对英国留在新加坡。条约把柔佛—廖内苏丹国一分为二，却没有一位马来统治者参加。标记放在马六甲海峡，也就是条约划线的地方；签约地点在伦敦。

title.zh: 1824 年 8 月 2 日的割让条约

summary.en: Sultan Hussein and the Temenggong ceded Singapore and the islands within ten geographical miles to the East India Company for ever.
summary.zh: 苏丹胡先和天猛公把新加坡岛及周围 10 地理英里以内的岛屿永久割让给东印度公司。

detail.en: The Sultan received $33,200 and $1,300 a month for life, the Temenggong $26,800 and $700 a month. John Crawfurd, the Resident, signed for the Company. Where it was signed is not known; the marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 苏丹得到 33,200 元，终身每月 1,300 元；天猛公得到 26,800 元，每月 700 元。驻扎官克劳福代表公司签字。签约地点不详，标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: A count in January 1824 found 10,683 people: 4,580 Malays, 3,317 Chinese, 1,925 Bugis and others, 756 Indians, and a few Europeans, Armenians and Arabs.
summary.zh: 1824 年 1 月的点算共有 10,683 人：马来人 4,580、华人 3,317、武吉斯人等 1,925、印度人 756，另有少数欧洲人、亚米尼亚人和阿拉伯人。

detail.en: It was a simple tally, not a census in the modern sense, and it probably missed many people living on boats. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 这只是简单的点算，不是现代意义上的普查，很可能漏掉许多住在船上的人。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: In 1826 the East India Company joined Penang, Malacca and Singapore as one colony, with its first seat at Penang.
summary.zh: 1826 年，东印度公司把槟城、马六甲和新加坡合为一个殖民地，首府最初设在槟城。

detail.en: A royal charter of 27 November 1826 gave the three settlements one court of justice; the exact day the colony began to be run as one is not recorded in the sources read. The marker is George Town.
detail.zh: 1826 年 11 月 27 日的皇家特许状为三地设立统一的法院；殖民地从哪一天开始合并管理，所读资料没有记载。标记放在乔治市。

summary.en: In 1832 the seat of the Straits Settlements moved from Penang to Singapore, by then the busiest of the three ports.
summary.zh: 1832 年，海峡殖民地的首府从槟城迁到新加坡；那时新加坡已是三地中最繁忙的港口。

detail.en: The marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: Under the 1824 treaty the Dutch handed Malacca to the British in 1825.
summary.zh: 按 1824 年的条约，荷兰在 1825 年把马六甲交给英国。

detail.en: A Dutch proclamation is dated 9 April 1825, but the day of the handover has not been checked in the original. The marker is the town.
detail.zh: 有一份荷兰公告的日期是 1825 年 4 月 9 日，但交接的确切日子没有在原件里核实。标记放在马六甲市区。

summary.en: In 1831–32 British troops fought the Malay chiefdom of Naning, inland from Malacca, after its chief refused the tax the British demanded.
summary.zh: 1831 年至 1832 年，马六甲内陆的马来酋邦南宁的酋长拒绝英国人要求的税，英军与之交战。

detail.en: The first expedition failed; a larger one in 1832 took Naning, which was joined to Malacca. The marker is the Naning district.
detail.zh: 第一次出兵失败；1832 年英军加派兵力攻下南宁，把它并入马六甲。标记放在南宁一带。

summary.en: During the First Opium War British forces occupied Hong Kong island on 26 January 1841; it became another free port on the China trade.
summary.zh: 第一次鸦片战争期间，英军在 1841 年 1 月 26 日占领香港岛；香港成为对华贸易的另一个自由港。

detail.en: Hong Kong both competed with and fed Singapore's trade. The marker is Victoria (Central).
detail.zh: 香港既和新加坡竞争，也为新加坡带来生意。标记放在维多利亚城（中环）。

summary.en: Formed in 1864 to build deep-water wharves and a dry dock west of the town, ready for steamships.
summary.zh: 1864 年成立，在城区以西兴建深水码头和干船坞，迎接蒸汽船。

detail.en: Its wharves became the heart of the port. The government bought the company in 1905. The marker is the Keppel Harbour area.
detail.zh: 它的码头成了港口的中心。1905 年政府收购了这家公司。标记放在吉宝港一带。

summary.en: On 1 April 1867 the Straits Settlements were transferred from British India to the Colonial Office in London.
summary.zh: 1867 年 4 月 1 日，海峡殖民地从英属印度政府转归伦敦的殖民地部管理。

detail.en: Merchants in Singapore had long complained that Calcutta neglected the Straits. The marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 新加坡的商人长期抱怨加尔各答不重视海峡殖民地。标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: The canal opened on 17 November 1869, cutting the sea route from Europe to Asia by thousands of kilometres.
summary.zh: 运河在 1869 年 11 月 17 日通航，从欧洲到亚洲的海路缩短了几千公里。

detail.en: Steamships could now use the Red Sea route, and more of Europe's trade with East Asia passed through Singapore. The marker is Port Said.
detail.zh: 蒸汽船从此可以走红海航线，欧洲与东亚之间更多的贸易经过新加坡。标记放在塞得港。

summary.en: In February 1821 the first junk from Amoy (Xiamen) reached Singapore; Chinese traders from Riau and Malacca had come earlier.
summary.zh: 1821 年 2 月，第一艘从厦门来的帆船到达新加坡；在此之前，已有华商从廖内和马六甲迁来。

detail.en: From then on junks came south every year on the north-east monsoon. The marker is the river mouth.
detail.zh: 此后每年都有帆船趁东北季风南来。标记放在河口。

summary.en: Convicts from India first reached Singapore in April 1825, on the 18th according to one account and the 25th according to another.
summary.zh: 印度罪犯 1825 年 4 月首次被押到新加坡，一说 18 日，一说 25 日。

detail.en: They cleared land, drained swamps and built roads, bridges and public buildings, often in fetters. Their jail stood at Bras Basah, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 他们开荒、排干沼泽，修建道路、桥梁和公共建筑，常常戴着镣铐。他们的监狱在百胜路一带，标记就在那里。

summary.en: Britain stopped sending convicts to the Straits in the 1860s; the last Indian convicts left Singapore in May 1873.
summary.zh: 英国在 1860 年代停止把罪犯送往海峡殖民地；最后一批印度罪犯在 1873 年 5 月离开新加坡。

detail.en: Some former convicts stayed on as free men and worked as craftsmen and traders. The marker is the old jail site at Bras Basah.
detail.zh: 有些刑满的罪犯以自由人的身份留下，当工匠或做买卖。标记放在百胜路的旧监狱一带。

summary.en: On 3 May 1877 William Pickering became the first Protector of Chinese, to register labour brokers and lodging houses and protect new arrivals and, later, women and girls.
summary.zh: 1877 年 5 月 3 日，毕麒麟出任第一任华民护卫司，负责登记劳工中介和客馆，保护新来的移民，后来也保护妇女和少女。

detail.en: Pickering spoke Chinese, which was rare among colonial officials. The first office was a shophouse on North Canal Road, near Boat Quay, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 毕麒麟会讲华语，这在殖民地官员中很少见。第一间办事处是驳船码头附近北运河路的一间店屋，标记就在那里。

summary.en: An ordinance of 1876 set rules for recruiting and shipping Indian labourers to the Straits; in Singapore it came into force only in 1883 and was replaced in 1884.
summary.zh: 1876 年的一项法令规定了招募和运送印度劳工到海峡殖民地的规则；在新加坡要到 1883 年才生效，1884 年被新法令取代。

detail.en: It aimed to curb the abuses of the labour trade from India while keeping the plantations supplied with workers. The marker is the town centre.
detail.zh: 它要遏制印度劳工买卖中的弊端，同时又要保证种植园有工人可用。标记放在城区中心。

summary.en: The first systematic census, on 2 April 1871, counted 97,111 people, more than half of them Chinese.
summary.zh: 1871 年 4 月 2 日第一次系统的人口普查，共有 97,111 人，其中一半以上是华人。

detail.en: A later study gives 96,087; the two totals may count different groups. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 后来的一项研究给出的数字是 96,087 人，两个总数可能统计的范围不同。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: Singapore's oldest Hindu temple, begun in 1827 in wood and attap on South Bridge Road and rebuilt in brick in 1843.
summary.zh: 新加坡最古老的兴都庙，1827 年在桥南路以木头和亚答叶建成，1843 年改建为砖造。

detail.en: It was founded by Naraina Pillai, a Tamil merchant who came with Raffles in 1819. The marker is the present temple.
detail.zh: 它由 1819 年随莱佛士来的泰米尔商人纳莱那·比莱创建。标记放在今天的庙址。

summary.en: A mosque founded in 1826 by Chulia Muslims from the Coromandel coast of India, a short walk from Sri Mariamman.
summary.zh: 1826 年由来自印度科罗曼德尔海岸的注辇穆斯林创建，与马里安曼兴都庙只隔几步。

detail.en: The marker is the present mosque on South Bridge Road.
detail.zh: 标记放在桥南路今天的清真寺。

summary.en: The first mosque was built in 1824–26 for Sultan Hussein; the present building was put up between 1924 and 1932.
summary.zh: 第一座清真寺建于 1824 年至 1826 年，供苏丹胡先使用；今天的建筑是 1924 年至 1932 年间建成的。

detail.en: The marker is the present mosque at Kampong Glam.
detail.zh: 标记放在甘榜格南今天的清真寺。

summary.en: Hokkien merchants built this temple to Mazu, goddess of the sea, on Telok Ayer Street in 1839–42, when the street ran along the shore.
summary.zh: 福建商人在 1839 年至 1842 年间，在当时还沿着海岸的直落亚逸街建起这座供奉海神妈祖的庙。

detail.en: Sailors gave thanks here after a safe voyage. After the Telok Ayer reclamation the temple stood inland. The marker is the present temple.
detail.zh: 水手平安抵达后来这里谢神。直落亚逸填海之后，天福宫就离海远了。标记放在今天的庙址。

summary.en: Built in 1835 for Singapore's small Armenian community, it is the oldest church still standing in Singapore.
summary.zh: 1835 年为新加坡人数不多的亚米尼亚人社群兴建，是新加坡现存最古老的教堂。

detail.en: It was designed by George D. Coleman and consecrated in 1836. The marker is the present church on Hill Street.
detail.zh: 教堂由哥里门设计，1836 年祝圣。标记放在禧街今天的教堂。

summary.en: The present cathedral was built in 1856–61 by Indian convict labourers.
summary.zh: 今天的座堂在 1856 年至 1861 年间由印度罪犯劳工建成。

detail.en: It replaced an earlier church on the same site. The marker is the present cathedral.
detail.zh: 它取代了原址上的一座旧教堂。标记放在今天的座堂。

summary.en: In 1844 the merchant Tan Tock Seng paid for a hospital for the poor of every community on Pearl's Hill.
summary.zh: 1844 年，商人陈笃生出钱在珍珠山兴建医院，收治各族的穷人。

detail.en: Sources give 25 May and 25 July 1844 for the foundation. The hospital moved twice and is now at Novena. The marker is the old Pearl's Hill site.
detail.zh: 奠基日期有 1844 年 5 月 25 日和 7 月 25 日两种说法。医院后来两次搬迁，今天在诺维娜。标记放在珍珠山的旧址。

summary.en: The school whose foundation stone Raffles laid in 1823 stood at Bras Basah, where Raffles City is now.
summary.zh: 莱佛士 1823 年奠基的学校位于百胜路，也就是今天莱佛士城的位置。

detail.en: It later became Raffles Institution, which moved away in 1972. The marker is the old site.
detail.zh: 它后来成为莱佛士书院，1972 年迁离此地。标记放在旧址。

summary.en: The 1822 plan put the Chinese kampong on the south bank of the river; the area became known as Kreta Ayer, “water cart”, after the carts that brought fresh water.
summary.zh: 1822 年的规划把华人甘榜划在河的南岸；这一带后来叫“牛车水”，得名于运送淡水的牛车。

detail.en: Hokkien, Teochew, Cantonese and other groups each clustered in their own streets. The marker is the district.
detail.zh: 福建、潮州、广府等籍贯的人，各自聚居在不同的街道。标记放在这一地区。

summary.en: The area set aside for the Sultan, the Bugis and Arab traders in the 1822 plan; it became the centre of Malay and Muslim life in the town.
summary.zh: 1822 年的规划把这里划给苏丹、武吉士和阿拉伯商人；后来成为城里马来人和穆斯林生活的中心。

detail.en: Pilgrims to Mecca, booksellers, printers and traders from across the archipelago gathered here. The marker is the district.
detail.zh: 前往麦加的朝圣者、书商、印刷商和来自群岛各地的商人聚集在这里。标记放在这一地区。

summary.en: An old road running north from the town; from the mid-nineteenth century Indians who kept cattle and worked in the brick kilns settled along it, the start of Little India.
summary.zh: 一条从城区向北的老路；19 世纪中叶起，养牛和在砖窑做工的印度人在路边聚居，这就是小印度的由来。

detail.en: The marker is the Tekka area, the old centre of Little India.
detail.zh: 标记放在竹脚一带，小印度的旧中心。

summary.en: From 5 May 1854 fighting between Hokkien and Teochew groups spread from the town to the plantations for about ten days; 400 to 500 people were killed.
summary.zh: 1854 年 5 月 5 日起，福建帮与潮州帮的冲突从城里蔓延到种植园，持续约十天，400 至 500 人被杀。

detail.en: The colonial records Buckley used give 400 or more dead; a later NLB account gives about 500. Hundreds of houses were burned, and troops and special constables were called out. The victims' names were not recorded. The marker is in the town; much of the killing took place inland.
detail.zh: 巴克利所用的殖民地记录说死了 400 多人，后来新加坡国家图书馆管理局的一篇文章说约 500 人。数以百计的房屋被烧，政府出动军队和临时警察。死者的名字没有记录。标记放在城里，但很多杀戮发生在内陆。

summary.en: From 1879 the bay in front of Telok Ayer Street was filled in, creating the land on which Robinson Road and Anson Road were later built; one record says it was finished by 1890, another 1897.
summary.zh: 1879 年起，直落亚逸街前面的海湾被填平，后来罗敏申路和安顺路就建在这片新地上；一份记录说 1890 年完工，另一份说 1897 年。

detail.en: Much of the earth came from levelling Mount Wallich and other hills. The town shore on the map moves out in 1887, using an 1893 map. The marker is the Raffles Place area.
detail.zh: 许多泥土来自削平华利山等小山。地图上的城区海岸在 1887 年向外推出，用的是 1893 年的地图。标记放在莱佛士坊一带。

summary.en: On 15 December 1876 protests began against a new government post office for letters to China; when police fired near Ellenborough Market, three people were killed.
summary.zh: 1876 年 12 月 15 日，人们抗议政府新设寄往中国的邮政局；警察在爱伦堡巴刹附近开枪，打死 3 人。

detail.en: The government blamed the secret societies. Historians also point to the remittance houses, whose business of carrying letters and money home was threatened. The marker is the Raffles Place area.
detail.zh: 政府归咎于私会党。也有史家指出，这个邮政局威胁到批局（侨批馆）寄信寄钱回乡的生意。标记放在莱佛士坊一带。

summary.en: Signed on 20 January 1874 on a ship off Pangkor island: Raja Abdullah was recognised as Sultan of Perak, and a British Resident would advise him in all matters except religion and Malay custom.
summary.zh: 1874 年 1 月 20 日在邦咯岛外的船上签订：拉惹阿都拉被承认为霹雳苏丹，英国驻扎官在宗教和马来习俗以外的一切事务上向他提供意见。

detail.en: The treaty also ended fighting between Chinese mining groups in Larut. It was the start of British rule through Residents in the Malay states. The marker is Pangkor.
detail.zh: 条约同时结束了拿律华人矿工帮派之间的战斗。这是英国通过驻扎官统治马来州属的开始。标记放在邦咯。

summary.en: After the first Resident, J. W. W. Birch, was killed at Pasir Salak in November 1875, British and Indian troops fought Malay chiefs in Perak until 1876.
summary.zh: 1875 年 11 月第一任驻扎官毕治在巴西沙叻被杀，英国和印度部队与霹雳的马来酋长交战，直到 1876 年。

detail.en: Birch had pressed the chiefs over taxes and the freeing of debt-slaves. British accounts called his killing murder; in Malaysia the chiefs who opposed him, such as Maharaja Lela, are remembered as fighters against colonial rule. The marker is Pasir Salak.
detail.zh: 毕治在收税和释放债奴的问题上向酋长们施压。英国的记载把他的死称为谋杀；在马来西亚，反对他的酋长如拿督马哈拉惹里拉，被纪念为反殖民的斗士。标记放在巴西沙叻。

summary.en: On 1 July 1896 Perak, Selangor, Negeri Sembilan and Pahang were joined under a British Resident-General in Kuala Lumpur, each keeping its ruler.
summary.zh: 1896 年 7 月 1 日，霹雳、雪兰莪、森美兰和彭亨合并，由驻吉隆坡的英国总驻扎官统辖，各州保留自己的统治者。

detail.en: The marker is Kuala Lumpur.
detail.zh: 标记放在吉隆坡。

summary.en: On 11 December 1885 Britain recognised Abu Bakar as Sultan of Johor; in return Johor left its foreign relations to Britain.
summary.zh: 1885 年 12 月 11 日，英国承认阿布巴卡为柔佛苏丹；柔佛则把外交事务交给英国。

detail.en: Johor accepted a British General Adviser only in 1914, later than the other states. The treaty was signed in London, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 柔佛直到 1914 年才接受英国的总顾问，比其他州晚。条约在伦敦签订，标记放在伦敦。

summary.en: On 1 January 1907 the island of Labuan, off Borneo, became part of the Straits Settlements.
summary.zh: 1907 年 1 月 1 日，婆罗洲外海的纳闽岛并入海峡殖民地。

detail.en: The marker is Victoria, Labuan's town.
detail.zh: 标记放在纳闽的维多利亚镇。

summary.en: Signed in Bangkok on 10 March 1909 and in force on 9 July: Siam gave up its claims over Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu to Britain.
summary.zh: 1909 年 3 月 10 日在曼谷签订，7 月 9 日生效：暹罗把对吉打、玻璃市、吉兰丹和登嘉楼的宗主权交给英国。

detail.en: The rulers of the four states were not party to it. In return Britain gave up some legal rights in Siam and lent money for a railway. The marker is Bangkok.
detail.zh: 四州的统治者都没有参与。作为交换，英国放弃在暹罗的部分司法特权，并贷款修铁路。标记放在曼谷。

summary.en: On 15 February 1915 part of the 5th Light Infantry, an Indian regiment, mutinied; 44 people were killed, British, Chinese and Malay soldiers and civilians.
summary.zh: 1915 年 2 月 15 日，印度第五轻步兵团部分官兵兵变；44 人被杀，包括英国、华人和马来军人与平民。

detail.en: The mutiny began at Alexandra Barracks and lasted almost a week. It was put down by volunteers, police, sailors from British, French, Russian and Japanese ships and the Sultan of Johor's forces. The marker is the Alexandra area; the barracks no longer stand.
detail.zh: 兵变从亚历山大兵营开始，持续将近一周。镇压兵变的有志愿兵、警察，英、法、俄、日军舰的水兵，以及柔佛苏丹的部队。标记放在亚历山大一带，兵营已不存在。

summary.en: Courts martial sentenced 47 or more mutineers to death; they were shot in public outside Outram Prison from March 1915, 22 of them together on 25 March.
summary.zh: 军事法庭判处 47 名或更多兵变者死刑；1915 年 3 月起，他们在欧南监狱外被公开枪决，3 月 25 日一次就枪决 22 人。

detail.en: One account says 15,000 people watched on one occasion. Others were transported or jailed. The marker is the site of Outram Prison, since demolished.
detail.zh: 一份记载说，有一次围观的人多达 15,000 人。另有一些人被流放或监禁。标记放在已拆除的欧南监狱旧址。

summary.en: The Causeway across the Johor Strait was formally opened on 28 June 1924; goods trains had been crossing since September 1923.
summary.zh: 横跨柔佛海峡的长堤在 1924 年 6 月 28 日正式启用；货运火车 1923 年 9 月就已通行。

detail.en: It carried a railway, a road and later water pipes from Johor. The marker is the Causeway today.
detail.zh: 长堤上有铁路、公路，后来还有从柔佛输水的水管。标记放在今天的长堤。

summary.en: On 12 March 1927, at a memorial on the second anniversary of Sun Yat-sen's death, police fired on a crowd outside the Kreta Ayer police station; six men died and 14 were injured.
summary.zh: 1927 年 3 月 12 日，在孙中山逝世两周年的纪念会上，警察在牛车水警察局外向人群开枪，6 人死亡，14 人受伤。

detail.en: An inquest found the six had died of police gunshot wounds; the government said the police had been attacked. The marker is the Kreta Ayer district.
detail.zh: 死因调查庭认定 6 人死于警察开枪；政府说警察先遭到攻击。标记放在牛车水一带。

summary.en: The census of 1 April 1931 counted 557,745 people on Singapore island: 75 percent Chinese, 12 percent Malays and 9 percent Indians.
summary.zh: 1931 年 4 月 1 日的普查，新加坡岛共有 557,745 人：华人占 75%，马来人占 12%，印度人占 9%。

detail.en: Counting took place on 2 April, as at midnight the night before. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 点算在 4 月 2 日进行，以前一天午夜为准。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: In 1935 Britain handed the Dindings, a strip of coast and islands taken from Perak in 1874, back to Perak.
summary.zh: 1935 年，英国把 1874 年从霹雳划出的天定（一段海岸和几座岛）归还霹雳。

detail.en: The marker is Lumut. The map does not draw the Pangkor islands, which belonged to the Dindings.
detail.zh: 标记放在红土坎。地图没有画出属于天定的邦咯诸岛。

summary.en: On 18 October 1943 Japan handed Kedah, Perlis, Kelantan and Terengganu to its ally Thailand, which had ruled or claimed them before 1909.
summary.zh: 1943 年 10 月 18 日，日本把吉打、玻璃市、吉兰丹和登嘉楼交给盟国泰国；1909 年以前，这四州曾在暹罗治下或由暹罗声索。

detail.en: Japan kept control of the railways and other strategic assets. The British took the states back in 1945. The marker is Alor Setar in Kedah.
detail.zh: 日本仍然掌握铁路等战略设施。1945 年英国收回四州。标记放在吉打的亚罗士打。

summary.en: From 5 November 1944 to March 1945 American bombers attacked the naval base, the docks and oil stores; civilians near the targets were killed, but no reliable count has been found.
summary.zh: 1944 年 11 月 5 日至 1945 年 3 月，美国轰炸机空袭海军基地、船坞和油库；目标附近的平民有死伤，但至今没有找到可靠的数字。

detail.en: On 5 November 1944, 53 B-29s struck the King George VI dry dock. The figures in the official American history are the attackers' own assessments of damage. The marker is the naval base at Sembawang; later raids hit Keppel Harbour and the Empire Dock.
detail.zh: 1944 年 11 月 5 日，53 架 B-29 轰炸乔治六世干船坞。美国官方战史里的数字，是进攻一方自己对破坏的估计。标记放在三巴旺的海军基地；后来的空袭也打到吉宝港和帝国船坞。

summary.en: From late 1943 the occupation government sent Eurasian and Chinese Catholic families to farm at Bahau in Negeri Sembilan; about 3,000 went.
summary.zh: 1943 年年底起，占领当局把欧亚裔和华人天主教徒家庭送到森美兰的马口垦荒，约 3,000 人前往。

detail.en: Malaria and hunger killed many: one account gives about 500 deaths, others up to 1,500. Bishop Adrian Devals died there in January 1945. The camp was some miles from the town of Bahau, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 疟疾和饥饿夺去许多人的生命：一份记载说约 500 人，另有估计高达 1,500 人。德华礼主教 1945 年 1 月死在那里。垦殖区离马口镇有几英里，标记放在镇上。

summary.en: From September 1943 Chinese families from Singapore were moved to a farming settlement at Endau in Johor, to ease the food shortage; by the end of its first year there were 12,000 settlers.
summary.zh: 1943 年 9 月起，新加坡的华人家庭被迁到柔佛兴楼的垦殖区种粮，以缓解粮荒；第一年年底已有 12,000 名移民。

detail.en: The marker is the town of Endau.
detail.zh: 标记放在兴楼镇。

summary.en: After the Japanese surrender the British ran Singapore and Malaya under a military administration until 31 March 1946.
summary.zh: 日本投降后，英国以军政府管理新加坡和马来亚，直到 1946 年 3 月 31 日。

detail.en: Its proclamation was signed on 15 August 1945; British troops landed in Singapore on 5 September, and the formal surrender took place on 12 September. Food shortages, high prices and the black market marked these months. The marker is City Hall.
detail.zh: 军政府的公告在 1945 年 8 月 15 日签署；英军 9 月 5 日在新加坡登陆，9 月 12 日举行正式受降。这几个月里，粮荒、高物价和黑市是常态。标记放在政府大厦。

title.zh: 新加坡成为单独的殖民地

summary.en: On 1 April 1946 the Straits Settlements were dissolved and Singapore became a Crown Colony on its own.
summary.zh: 1946 年 4 月 1 日，海峡殖民地解散，新加坡单独成为直辖殖民地。

detail.en: Penang and Malacca joined the Malayan Union instead. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 槟城和马六甲则加入马来亚联邦。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: On 1 April 1946 Britain joined the Malay states, Penang and Malacca into one colony, reducing the sultans' powers and opening citizenship to many non-Malays.
summary.zh: 1946 年 4 月 1 日，英国把各马来州、槟城和马六甲合为一个殖民地，削弱苏丹的权力，并让许多非马来人取得公民权。

detail.en: The sultans' agreement had been obtained in haste in 1945. Malay protests led to its replacement in 1948. The marker is Kuala Lumpur.
detail.zh: 苏丹们的同意是 1945 年匆忙取得的。马来人的抗议使它在 1948 年被取代。标记放在吉隆坡。

summary.en: On 11 May 1946, at the Istana Besar in Johor Bahru, Malay associations formed the United Malays National Organisation to oppose the Malayan Union.
summary.zh: 1946 年 5 月 11 日，各马来团体在新山的大皇宫成立马来民族统一机构（巫统），反对马来亚联邦。

detail.en: Onn Jaafar was its first president. The marker is the Istana Besar.
detail.zh: 首任主席是拿督翁惹化。标记放在大皇宫。

summary.en: On 1 February 1948 the Federation of Malaya replaced the Malayan Union, restoring the sultans' position and tightening citizenship; Singapore stayed outside.
summary.zh: 1948 年 2 月 1 日，马来亚联合邦取代马来亚联邦，恢复苏丹的地位，收紧公民权；新加坡仍在外面。

detail.en: The federation agreement had been signed on 21 January. The marker is Kuala Lumpur.
detail.zh: 联合邦协议在 1 月 21 日签署。标记放在吉隆坡。

summary.en: On 20 March 1948 voters chose six of the Legislative Council's members; 22,395 people had registered and 14,126 voted.
summary.zh: 1948 年 3 月 20 日，选民选出立法议会的 6 名议员；登记选民 22,395 人，投票 14,126 人。

detail.en: The Progressive Party won three seats and independents three. Most members were still appointed. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 进步党赢得 3 席，独立人士 3 席。大多数议员仍是委任的。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: After communist guerrillas killed three European planters near Sungai Siput, Perak, on 16 June 1948, an Emergency was declared in Malaya on 18 June and in Singapore on 24 June.
summary.zh: 1948 年 6 月 16 日，共产党游击队在霹雳双溪大年附近杀害三名欧洲种植园主；6 月 18 日马来亚、6 月 24 日新加坡宣布进入紧急状态。

detail.en: It lasted until 1960. The government could detain people without trial, ban organisations and move whole villages. The marker is Sungai Siput.
detail.zh: 紧急状态持续到 1960 年。政府可以不经审判扣押人、查禁团体、迁移整个村庄。标记放在双溪大年。

summary.en: From 11 to 13 December 1950, after a court case over the custody of a girl raised as a Muslim, rioters attacked Europeans and Eurasians; 18 people were killed and 173 injured.
summary.zh: 1950 年 12 月 11 日至 13 日，一宗被当作穆斯林抚养长大的女孩的监护权官司之后，暴乱者袭击欧洲人和欧亚裔，18 人死亡，173 人受伤。

detail.en: Police and troops opened fire; the dead included people attacked by rioters and rioters shot by the security forces. 1,168 people were arrested for rioting and about 500 detained under emergency laws; curfews lasted until 19 December. The marker is in the town; the riot began outside the Supreme Court and spread.
detail.zh: 警察和军队开枪；死者中有被暴乱者袭击的人，也有被军警击毙的暴乱者。1,168 人以暴乱罪被捕，约 500 人依紧急法令被扣押；宵禁持续到 12 月 19 日。标记放在城区；暴乱从最高法院外开始，然后蔓延。

summary.en: On 2 April 1955, under the Rendel constitution, voters chose 25 of the 32 seats in a new Legislative Assembly; the Labour Front won 10 and David Marshall became Chief Minister.
summary.zh: 1955 年 4 月 2 日，依照林德宪制，选民在新立法议院 32 个议席中选出 25 席；劳工阵线赢得 10 席，马绍尔出任首席部长。

detail.en: Automatic registration raised the number of voters to 300,299. The People's Action Party, founded in 1954, won three seats. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 实行自动登记后，选民增加到 300,299 人。1954 年成立的人民行动党赢得 3 席。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: On 12 May 1955 a strike at the Hock Lee bus depot turned into a riot; four people died and 31 were injured.
summary.zh: 1955 年 5 月 12 日，福利巴士车厂的罢工演变成暴乱，4 人死亡，31 人受伤。

detail.en: The dead were Corporal Andrew Teo Bok Lan of the Volunteer Special Constabulary, Detective Corporal Yuen Yau Pang, the American journalist Gene Symonds and the 16-year-old student Chong Lon Chong, who was shot; who fired the shot was never established. The marker is the junction of Alexandra Road and Dawson Road, near the old depot.
detail.zh: 死者是志愿特警队下士 Andrew Teo Bok Lan、便衣警探下士 Yuen Yau Pang、美国记者 Gene Symonds，以及中枪的 16 岁学生 Chong Lon Chong；是谁开的枪始终没有查明。标记放在亚历山大路与道生路交界处，靠近旧车厂。

summary.en: David Marshall resigned as Chief Minister in June 1956 after the London talks on self-government broke down over internal security; Lim Yew Hock succeeded him.
summary.zh: 自治谈判在内部安全问题上破裂，马绍尔在 1956 年 6 月辞去首席部长职务，由林有福接任。

detail.en: One NLB article gives 6 June, another 7 June. The marker is the old Assembly House.
detail.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局的一篇文章写 6 月 6 日，另一篇写 6 月 7 日。标记放在旧国会大厦。

summary.en: After the government dissolved the Chinese middle-school students' union and expelled student leaders, students occupied their schools; when police moved in on 25–26 October, riots spread and 13 people were killed and 123 injured.
summary.zh: 政府解散华文中学学生联合会、开除学生领袖之后，学生留守学校；10 月 25 日至 26 日警察进校清场，骚乱蔓延，13 人死亡，123 人受伤。

detail.en: A curfew began just after midnight on 26 October; order was restored on 28 October. 290 people were arrested for rioting, 962 for breaking the curfew and 912 detained under the security laws. The marker is the Chinese High School, one of the occupied schools.
detail.zh: 10 月 26 日凌晨实施宵禁，28 日恢复秩序。290 人以暴乱罪被捕，962 人因违反宵禁被捕，912 人依安全法令被扣押。标记放在被学生留守的学校之一，华侨中学。

summary.en: On 31 August 1957 the Federation of Malaya became independent, with Tunku Abdul Rahman as Prime Minister; Singapore remained a British colony.
summary.zh: 1957 年 8 月 31 日，马来亚联合邦独立，东姑阿都拉曼出任首相；新加坡仍是英国殖民地。

detail.en: Independence was proclaimed at Merdeka Stadium in Kuala Lumpur, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 独立在吉隆坡的独立体育场宣布，标记就在那里。

summary.en: A citizenship ordinance of 1957 created Singapore citizenship; between 1 November 1957 and 31 January 1958 more than 320,000 people registered.
summary.zh: 1957 年的公民权法令设立新加坡公民权；1957 年 11 月 1 日至 1958 年 1 月 31 日，有 32 万多人登记。

detail.en: Many of them had been born in China, India or Malaya, and had not been able to vote before. The marker is the old Assembly House.
detail.zh: 他们许多人在中国、印度或马来亚出生，以前没有投票权。标记放在旧国会大厦。

summary.en: On 30 May 1959, in the first election for a fully elected Legislative Assembly, the People's Action Party won 43 of the 51 seats with 53.4 percent of the votes.
summary.zh: 1959 年 5 月 30 日，立法议院第一次全部议席民选，人民行动党以 53.4% 的得票率赢得 51 席中的 43 席。

detail.en: Voting was compulsory and 586,098 people were registered. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 投票是强制的，登记选民 586,098 人。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: On 3 June 1959 Singapore became a self-governing state: its elected government ran internal affairs, while Britain kept defence and foreign affairs.
summary.zh: 1959 年 6 月 3 日，新加坡成为自治邦：民选政府管理内政，英国仍掌管国防和外交。

detail.en: An Internal Security Council of British, Singapore and Malayan members oversaw security. That evening the PAP held a rally on the steps of City Hall, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 由英国、新加坡和马来亚代表组成的内部安全理事会掌管安全事务。当晚人民行动党在政府大厦台阶上举行群众大会，标记就在那里。

summary.en: On 5 June 1959 Lee Kuan Yew and eight ministers were sworn in at City Hall.
summary.zh: 1959 年 6 月 5 日，李光耀和八名部长在政府大厦宣誓就职。

detail.en: The ministers were Toh Chin Chye, Goh Keng Swee, Ong Eng Guan, Ahmad Ibrahim, K. M. Byrne, S. Rajaratnam, Ong Pang Boon and Yong Nyuk Lin. The marker is City Hall.
detail.zh: 八名部长是杜进才、吴庆瑞、王永元、阿末依布拉欣、拜恩、拉惹勒南、王邦文和杨玉麟。标记放在政府大厦。

summary.en: On 3 December 1959 Yusof Ishak was installed as Yang di-Pertuan Negara, the head of state, and the state flag, crest and anthem were unveiled.
summary.zh: 1959 年 12 月 3 日，尤索夫·伊萨就任国家元首（Yang di-Pertuan Negara），州旗、州徽和州歌同时揭晓。

detail.en: He had founded the Malay newspaper Utusan Melayu. The anthem, “Majulah Singapura”, was written by Zubir Said. The marker is City Hall.
detail.zh: 他是马来文报《马来前锋报》的创办人之一。州歌《前进吧，新加坡》由朱比尔·赛义德创作。标记放在政府大厦。

title.zh: 东姑提出马来西亚构想

summary.en: On 27 May 1961, speaking to foreign correspondents in Singapore, Tunku Abdul Rahman proposed a closer association of Malaya, Singapore, North Borneo, Sarawak and Brunei.
summary.zh: 1961 年 5 月 27 日，东姑阿都拉曼在新加坡对外国记者说，马来亚、新加坡、北婆罗洲、砂拉越和文莱应当更紧密地结合。

detail.en: The lunch was held at the Adelphi Hotel on Coleman Street, where the marker is.
detail.zh: 午宴在哥里门街的阿德菲酒店举行，标记就在那里。

summary.en: After the PAP's left wing broke away in July 1961, its members formed the Barisan Sosialis, registered on 13 August, with Lee Siew Choh as chairman and Lim Chin Siong as secretary-general.
summary.zh: 1961 年 7 月人民行动党左翼分裂出去，组成社会主义阵线，8 月 13 日注册，李绍祖任主席，林清祥任秘书长。

detail.en: Thirteen PAP assemblymen joined it. It opposed the terms of merger. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 13 名行动党议员加入社阵。社阵反对合并的条件。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: On 1 September 1962 voters chose among three forms of merger; 70.8 percent chose the government's option A and 25.7 percent cast blank ballots.
summary.zh: 1962 年 9 月 1 日，选民在三种合并方式中投票；70.8% 选了政府的 A 方案，25.7% 投了空白票。

detail.en: There was no option to reject merger, and unmarked ballots were to follow the majority in the Assembly. The Barisan Sosialis had urged blank votes and called the result a sham. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 没有“反对合并”的选项，空白票按规定算作跟随立法议院多数。社阵号召投空白票，并说这是一场“假公投”。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: On 8 December 1962 an armed rising by the North Kalimantan National Army broke out in Brunei; British troops put it down within days.
summary.zh: 1962 年 12 月 8 日，北加里曼丹国民军在文莱发动武装起事，几天内被英军镇压。

detail.en: The rebels were linked to A. M. Azahari's Brunei People's Party, which opposed joining Malaysia. The British account is used here; the rebels' own statements were not read. The Sultan of Brunei later decided not to join. The marker is Brunei Town.
detail.zh: 起事者与阿扎哈里领导、反对加入马来西亚的文莱人民党有关。这里用的是英国方面的记载，起事者自己的声明没有读到。文莱苏丹后来决定不加入。标记放在文莱市。

summary.en: On 2 February 1963 police arrested 107 opposition politicians, unionists, students and journalists, among them Lim Chin Siong; later counts reach 113. They were held without trial.
summary.zh: 1963 年 2 月 2 日，警方逮捕了 107 名反对党人士、工会人士、学生和记者，包括林清祥；后来的统计达到 113 人。他们未经审判被扣押。

detail.en: The Internal Security Council said they were communists planning violence and linked to the Brunei revolt. Detainees and some historians say it was a political operation against the main opposition. Both accounts are in the chapter. The marker is the middle of the island.
detail.zh: 内部安全理事会说，他们是策划暴力、与文莱起事有关的共产党人。被扣押者和一些史家则说，这是一次针对主要反对党的政治行动。两种说法都写在本章里。标记放在岛的中央。

summary.en: Signed in London on 9 July 1963 by Britain, Malaya, Singapore, North Borneo and Sarawak; Malaysia was to begin on 31 August.
summary.zh: 1963 年 7 月 9 日由英国、马来亚、新加坡、北婆罗洲和砂拉越在伦敦签署；马来西亚原定 8 月 31 日成立。

detail.en: The date was moved to 16 September to let a United Nations mission survey opinion in Borneo. On 31 August Lee Kuan Yew declared Singapore independent in the meantime. The marker is London.
detail.zh: 为了让联合国调查团了解婆罗洲的民意，日期改为 9 月 16 日。8 月 31 日，李光耀宣布新加坡在过渡期间独立。标记放在伦敦。

summary.en: On 16 September 1963 Malaya, Singapore, Sabah (North Borneo) and Sarawak became Malaysia; Brunei did not join.
summary.zh: 1963 年 9 月 16 日，马来亚、新加坡、沙巴（北婆罗洲）和砂拉越组成马来西亚，文莱没有加入。

detail.en: Indonesia and the Philippines did not recognise the new federation. Five days later the PAP won 37 of Singapore's 51 seats and the Barisan Sosialis 13. The marker is Merdeka Stadium in Kuala Lumpur, where Malaysia was proclaimed.
detail.zh: 印尼和菲律宾都不承认新联邦。五天后，人民行动党在新加坡 51 席中赢得 37 席，社阵 13 席。标记放在宣布马来西亚成立的吉隆坡独立体育场。

summary.en: On 20 January 1963 Indonesia's foreign minister, Subandrio, announced a policy of Confrontation against the planned Malaysia; armed raids into Sarawak began in April.
summary.zh: 1963 年 1 月 20 日，印尼外长苏班德里约宣布对计划中的马来西亚采取“对抗”政策；4 月起，武装人员越境袭击砂拉越。

detail.en: President Sukarno saw Malaysia as a British plan to keep power in the region. The Confrontation ended with a peace agreement on 11 August 1966. The marker is Kuching.
detail.zh: 苏卡诺总统认为马来西亚是英国保持区域势力的计划。对抗在 1966 年 8 月 11 日以和约结束。标记放在古晋。

summary.en: In April 1964 the PAP put up candidates on the peninsula for the first time; it won one seat, and the Alliance took most of the rest.
summary.zh: 1964 年 4 月，人民行动党第一次在半岛派出候选人，只赢得 1 席，大部分议席由联盟赢得。

detail.en: UMNO leaders saw the PAP's campaign as a challenge to their place in the federation. The marker is Kuala Lumpur.
detail.zh: 巫统领袖把行动党的竞选看作对他们在联邦中地位的挑战。标记放在吉隆坡。

summary.en: On 21 July 1964 a procession of about 20,000 people marking the Prophet Muhammad's birthday was passing Kallang when clashes broke out between Malays and Chinese; 23 people died and 454 were injured.
summary.zh: 1964 年 7 月 21 日，约 2 万人参加的庆祝先知穆罕默德诞辰游行经过加冷时，马来人与华人发生冲突，23 人死亡，454 人受伤。

detail.en: Four people died on the first day. A curfew was imposed that night and lifted on 2 August; fighting flared again on 6 August. 3,568 people were arrested. The PAP blamed UMNO activists and the campaign in Utusan Melayu; UMNO leaders called the riots spontaneous. The marker is the Kallang area, where the first clashes were reported.
detail.zh: 第一天就有 4 人死亡。当晚实施宵禁，8 月 2 日解除；8 月 6 日冲突再起。3,568 人被捕。行动党指责巫统活跃分子和《马来前锋报》的鼓动；巫统领袖说骚乱是自发的。标记放在最早报告冲突的加冷一带。

summary.en: After a 57-year-old Malay trishaw rider was killed in Geylang Serai, new riots broke out; 13 people died and 106 were injured.
summary.zh: 一名 57 岁的马来三轮车夫在芽笼士乃被杀后，骚乱再起，13 人死亡，106 人受伤。

detail.en: One NLB article dates the start to 2 September, another to 3 September. An island-wide curfew ran from 4 to 11 September; 1,439 people were arrested. Both the Singapore and Malaysian governments blamed Indonesian agents. The marker is Geylang Serai market.
detail.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局的一篇文章说骚乱 9 月 2 日开始，另一篇说 3 日。全岛宵禁从 9 月 4 日到 11 日；1,439 人被捕。新加坡和马来西亚两国政府都归咎于印尼特务。标记放在芽笼士乃巴刹。

summary.en: At 3.07 p.m. on 10 March 1965 a bomb set by two Indonesian marines exploded in MacDonald House on Orchard Road, killing three people and injuring 33.
summary.zh: 1965 年 3 月 10 日下午 3 时 07 分，两名印尼海军陆战队员放置的炸弹在乌节路麦唐纳大厦爆炸，3 人死亡，33 人受伤。

detail.en: The dead were Elizabeth Suzie Choo Kway Hoi and Juliet Goh Hwee Kuang, who worked in the bank there, and the driver Mohammed Yasin bin Kesit. The marines, Osman bin Haji Mohamed Ali and Harun bin Said, were hanged in October 1968. It was the deadliest of at least 42 Confrontation bomb attacks in Singapore. The marker is MacDonald House.
detail.zh: 死者是在大厦里的银行工作的 Elizabeth Suzie Choo Kway Hoi 和 Juliet Goh Hwee Kuang，以及司机 Mohammed Yasin bin Kesit。两名海军陆战队员 Osman bin Haji Mohamed Ali 和 Harun bin Said 在 1968 年 10 月被处绞刑。这是对抗期间新加坡至少 42 宗爆炸案中死伤最重的一宗。标记放在麦唐纳大厦。

summary.en: The agreement for Singapore to leave Malaysia was signed in Kuala Lumpur after midnight on 6–7 August 1965; other Singapore ministers signed on 7 and 8 August.
summary.zh: 新加坡脱离马来西亚的协议在 1965 年 8 月 6 日至 7 日午夜后于吉隆坡签署；其他新加坡部长在 8 月 7 日和 8 日补签。

detail.en: Goh Keng Swee and E. W. Barker negotiated it in secret with Abdul Razak and other Malaysian ministers. The marker is Kuala Lumpur.
detail.zh: 吴庆瑞和巴克与敦拉萨等马来西亚部长秘密谈判。标记放在吉隆坡。

summary.en: On 9 August 1965 the Proclamation of Singapore was broadcast at 10 a.m., and Malaysia's Parliament voted 126 to none, with one abstention, to let Singapore go.
summary.zh: 1965 年 8 月 9 日上午 10 时广播新加坡独立宣言；马来西亚国会以 126 票对 0 票、1 票弃权，通过让新加坡退出。

detail.en: In Parliament the Tunku said the only other course was “repressive measures” against Singapore's government. At a press conference that afternoon Lee Kuan Yew called it “a moment of anguish”. The marker is City Hall, where the Prime Minister's office was.
detail.zh: 东姑在国会说，另一条路只能是对新加坡政府采取“镇压手段”。当天下午，李光耀在记者会上称之为“痛苦的时刻”。标记放在总理办公室所在的政府大厦。

summary.en: On 9 August 1965 Lee Kuan Yew announced his Cabinet: Goh Keng Swee moved to Defence and Security, and S. Rajaratnam became Foreign Minister.
summary.zh: 1965 年 8 月 9 日，李光耀宣布内阁名单：吴庆瑞改任国防与安全部长，拉惹勒南出任外交部长。

detail.en: The ten ministers are listed in the chapter. The marker is City Hall.
detail.zh: 十名部长的名单见本章。标记放在政府大厦。

title.zh: 尤索夫·伊萨成为第一任总统

summary.en: On 22 December 1965 Singapore's Parliament changed the head of state's title to President, backdated to 9 August, making Yusof Ishak the first President.
summary.zh: 1965 年 12 月 22 日，新加坡国会把国家元首的称号改为总统，追溯至 8 月 9 日生效，尤索夫·伊萨成为第一任总统。

detail.en: The law deemed him President from independence; he did not take a new oath that day. Parliament had first met on 8 December. The marker is the old Parliament House.
detail.zh: 法律规定他从独立之日起就是总统，当天并没有重新宣誓。国会 12 月 8 日首次开会。标记放在旧国会大厦。

summary.en: Britain's naval base at Sembawang, begun in 1928, is officially opened with the King George VI Dock; it is called the 'Gibraltar of the East'.
summary.zh: 英国在三巴旺修建的海军基地 1928 年动工，与乔治六世船坞一同正式启用，被称为“东方直布罗陀”。

detail.en: The base was built to receive a British fleet sent from Europe in an emergency; no large fleet was stationed there. Planning assumed the fleet could arrive within 70 days of war breaking out; in September 1939, with war in Europe, the Chiefs of Staff extended this 'period before relief' to 180 days.
detail.zh: 基地是为了在紧急时接纳从欧洲派来的英国舰队而修的，平时并没有大舰队驻扎。计划假定开战后 70 天内舰队可以赶到；1939 年 9 月欧洲开战后，参谋长委员会把这一“待援期”延长到 180 天。

summary.en: Shortly after midnight on 8 December, about 5,600 Japanese troops land at Kota Bharu in north-east Malaya, about 70 minutes before the attack on Pearl Harbor.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日午夜过后，约 5,600 名日军在马来亚东北部的哥打巴鲁登陆，比珍珠港攻击早约 70 分钟。

detail.en: The landing was planned for 00:45 local time (17:15 GMT on 7 December), the Pearl Harbor attack for 18:25 GMT. The first flight at Kota Bharu was about 5,590 men of the 56th Infantry Regiment (Takumi Detachment); at the same time about 13,500 landed at Singora and 7,550 at Patani in southern Thailand. Indian troops of 8th Brigade held the beaches; Hudson bombers from the airfield damaged all three transports, and one sank the next day.
detail.zh: 登陆计划在当地时间 0 时 45 分（格林尼治 7 日 17 时 15 分），珍珠港攻击在格林尼治 18 时 25 分。哥打巴鲁的第一批是第 56 联队（佗美支队）约 5,590 人；同时约 13,500 人在泰国南部宋卡、7,550 人在北大年登陆。守卫海滩的是印度第 8 旅；从机场起飞的哈德逊轰炸机击伤全部三艘运输船，其中一艘次日沉没。

summary.en: Shortly after 4 a.m. on 8 December, 17 Japanese bombers from Indochina attack Singapore's city and air bases; 61 people are killed and 133 injured.
summary.zh: 12 月 8 日凌晨 4 时过后，17 架从印度支那起飞的日本轰炸机袭击新加坡市区和机场，61 人死亡、133 人受伤。

detail.en: The city was fully lit; the street lamps were not put out until the all-clear at 4.40 a.m. By January 1942 there were two to three raids a day. For January, Kirby gives some 600 civilians killed and 1,500 injured; a Singapore government account gives more than 1,000 killed. Both figures are listed.
detail.zh: 空袭时全城灯火通明，路灯直到凌晨 4 时 40 分解除警报后才熄灭。到 1942 年 1 月，每天有两三次空袭。关于 1 月的伤亡，Kirby 记为平民约 600 人死亡、1,500 人受伤；新加坡政府的资料写 1,000 多人死亡。两者并列。

summary.en: On the night of 8 February Japanese troops cross the Johor Strait and land on Singapore's north-west coast near Sarimbun, held by the 22nd Australian Brigade.
summary.zh: 2 月 8 日夜，日军渡过柔佛海峡，在新加坡西北海岸沙林汶一带登陆，那里由澳大利亚第 22 旅防守。

detail.en: After days of shelling, landing craft of the Japanese 5th and 18th Divisions attacked the coast between Tanjong Buloh and Tanjong Murai at about 10.30 p.m.; the heaviest assaults were north of Pulau Sarimbun. The defended localities were far apart and the Japanese moved inland between them. The Causeway had been breached on 31 January when the last Commonwealth troops crossed to the island.
detail.zh: 经过几天炮击，日军第 5、第 18 师团的登陆艇在晚上约 10 时 30 分进攻丹戎布罗至丹戎木莱一带海岸，最猛烈的进攻在沙林汶岛以北。守军据点相距很远，日军从中间穿插向内陆推进。1 月 31 日最后一批英联邦部队撤到岛上时，长堤已被炸开缺口。

summary.en: Japanese troops take Bukit Timah, the island's highest ground, in the centre of the island near the reservoirs that supply the city's water.
summary.zh: 日军攻占全岛最高处武吉知马，那里位于岛中央，靠近供应全城用水的水库。

detail.en: Fighting along the Bukit Timah road lasted from 10 to 11 February. By the morning of 14 February breaks in the water mains from bombing and shelling were losing more than half the supply from the reservoirs, and the municipal water engineer estimated it might last 24 to 48 hours.
detail.zh: 武吉知马路一带的战斗从 2 月 10 日持续到 11 日。到 2 月 14 日早上，轰炸和炮击打断的水管使水库一半以上的供水白白流失，市政水务工程师估计供水最多还能维持 24 到 48 小时。

summary.en: The Malay Regiment defends Pasir Panjang ridge and Bukit Chandu (Opium Hill) against the Japanese 18th Division; Lieutenant Adnan Saidi is captured and killed.
summary.zh: 马来军团在巴西班让山脊和武吉知卓（鸦片山）抵抗日军第 18 师团；阿南·赛迪中尉被俘后遇害。

detail.en: The Japanese 56th Infantry Regiment attacked the Pasir Panjang ridge on 13 February and took The Gap that evening. C Company of the 1st Battalion, Malay Regiment, held Bukit Chandu until the afternoon of 14 February. Second Lieutenant Adnan Saidi was captured and killed. The site is now the Reflections at Bukit Chandu museum.
detail.zh: 日军第 56 联队 2 月 13 日进攻巴西班让山脊，当晚夺取峡口。马来军团第一营 C 连守住武吉知卓直到 14 日下午。阿南·赛迪少尉被俘后遇害。那里现在是“武吉知卓之忆”纪念馆。

summary.en: Japanese soldiers enter the British Military Hospital at Alexandra and kill about 200 patients and staff over two days.
summary.zh: 日军士兵闯入亚历山大英军医院，两天内杀害约 200 名病人和医护人员。

detail.en: On 14 February soldiers bayoneted 50 unarmed patients and medical staff in the wards, including a patient on the operating table. About 200 patients and staff were marched to another building, held overnight without water, and shot the next day. Kirby records the Japanese claim that the hospital had been used as an artillery position. The hospital had twice as many patients as beds.
detail.zh: 2 月 14 日，日军士兵在病房里用刺刀杀死 50 名手无寸铁的病人和医护人员，其中包括手术台上的病人。约 200 名病人和医护人员被押到另一栋楼，关了一夜，没有水，次日被枪杀。Kirby 记录了日方的说法：医院曾被用作炮兵阵地。当时医院的病人是床位的两倍。

summary.en: Lieutenant-General Percival signs the surrender of Singapore to Lieutenant-General Yamashita at the Ford factory, Bukit Timah; fighting stops at 8.30 p.m.
summary.zh: 白思华中将在武吉知马福特车厂向山下奉文中将签字投降；晚上 8 时 30 分停火。

detail.en: Percival arrived at 5.15 p.m., Yamashita demanded unconditional surrender, and Percival signed at 6.10 p.m. The island garrison was about 85,000 men; over the 70-day campaign more than 130,000 British, Indian, Australian and local troops became prisoners. For Singapore it began three years and eight months of Japanese occupation; 15 February is now Total Defence Day.
detail.zh: 白思华下午 5 时 15 分到达，山下要求无条件投降，6 时 10 分白思华签字。岛上守军约 85,000 人；整个 70 天的战役中，英国、印度、澳大利亚和本地部队共 13 万多人成为战俘。新加坡由此进入三年零八个月的日据时期；2 月 15 日现在是全面防卫日。

summary.en: Japanese military police and soldiers screen Chinese men aged 18 to 50 across Singapore and take those they suspect of being anti-Japanese to beaches and other remote places to be shot.
summary.zh: 日本宪兵和军队在新加坡各地甄别 18 至 50 岁的华人男子，把被怀疑“抗日”的人押到海滩等偏僻地方枪杀。

detail.en: The screening ran from 18 February to 4 March 1942, carried out mainly by the Kempeitai in the city and by the Imperial Guard Division in the suburbs. Known killing sites include Changi Beach (66 men, 20 February) and Punggol beach (some 400, 28 February). The Japanese figure at the 1947 trial was about 5,000; a 25th Army record of May 1942 lists 11,110 'missing'; most estimates lie between 25,000 and 50,000, and Chinese community estimates go up to 100,000. The marker shows the screening centre at Jalan Besar, one of several.
detail.zh: 检证从 1942 年 2 月 18 日持续到 3 月 4 日，市区主要由宪兵队执行，郊区由近卫师团执行。已知的屠杀地点包括樟宜海滩（2 月 20 日，66 人）和榜鹅海滩（2 月 28 日，约 400 人）。1947 年审判时日方的数字约 5,000 人；第 25 军 1942 年 5 月的记录写有 11,110 人“失踪”；多数估计在 2.5 万至 5 万人之间，华人社会的估计最高到 10 万人。地图上的标记是惹兰勿刹的检证中心，这样的中心有好几处。

summary.en: After an Allied commando raid on Singapore harbour, the Kempeitai raid Changi Prison and take away 57 civilian internees; 15 die under interrogation.
summary.zh: 盟军突击队袭击新加坡港之后，宪兵队搜查樟宜监狱，带走 57 名被拘留的平民，其中 15 人死于审讯。

detail.en: On 26 September 1943 fourteen Australian and British commandos in canoes sank or damaged about 37,000 tonnes of shipping in the harbour (Operation Jaywick). The Kempeitai wrongly suspected the internees and local people of helping the raiders, and found a hidden wireless set in the prison. The suspects, among them Elizabeth Choy and her husband, were held and tortured at the Kempeitai's East District Branch in the old YMCA. From 18 March to 15 April 1946 a British military court in Singapore tried 21 Japanese soldiers and interpreters for the Double Tenth.
detail.zh: 1943 年 9 月 26 日，14 名澳大利亚和英国突击队员乘独木舟潜入港内，击沉或炸伤约 37,000 吨船只（杰威克行动）。宪兵队错误地怀疑是被拘留者和本地人接应了袭击者，并在监狱里搜出一台藏起来的无线电。嫌疑人，包括伊丽莎白·蔡和她的丈夫，被关在旧基督教青年会大楼里的宪兵队东区分队，遭到拷打。1946 年 3 月 18 日至 4 月 15 日，英国军事法庭在新加坡就双十事件审判了 21 名日本军人和翻译。

summary.en: In the Municipal Building, Admiral Lord Louis Mountbatten accepts the surrender of all Japanese forces in Southeast Asia from General Itagaki Seishirō.
summary.zh: 在市政大厦，蒙巴顿海军上将接受板垣征四郎大将代表东南亚全部日军投降。

detail.en: British troops had landed on 5 September, after the Japanese commanders signed the surrender of Singapore and Johore aboard HMS Sussex on 4 September; there were about 77,000 Japanese army, air force and naval personnel in Singapore and Johore. At the ceremony Itagaki signed eleven copies of the Instrument of Surrender, for the British, American, Chinese, French, Dutch, Australian, Indian and Japanese governments, the King, the Supreme Commander and the command's records. A victory parade followed on the Padang. Itagaki was later tried in Tokyo and hanged in 1948.
detail.zh: 9 月 4 日日军指挥官在萨塞克斯号上签署新加坡和柔佛的投降书，英军 9 月 5 日登陆；当时新加坡和柔佛有日本陆海空军约 7.7 万人。仪式上，板垣签署了十一份投降书，分别给英国、美国、中国、法国、荷兰、澳大利亚、印度和日本政府，以及英王、最高统帅和司令部存档。随后在大草场举行胜利游行。板垣后来在东京受审，1948 年被处绞刑。

summary.en: A British military court in Singapore tries seven Japanese officers for the Sook Ching massacre; two are sentenced to death and five to life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 英国军事法庭在新加坡审判七名与肃清屠杀有关的日本军官；两人被判死刑，五人终身监禁。

detail.en: The trial was held at the Victoria Memorial Hall from 10 March to 2 April 1947. All seven were found guilty; Lieutenant-General Kawamura Saburō, garrison commander of Singapore Town, and Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, the Kempeitai commander, were sentenced to death. It was one of 131 war-crimes trials held in Singapore between January 1946 and March 1948. The Japanese figure for the dead given at the trial, about 5,000, is far below most estimates.
detail.zh: 审判 1947 年 3 月 10 日至 4 月 2 日在维多利亚纪念堂举行。七人全部有罪；新加坡市区警备司令河村参郎中将和宪兵队指挥官大石正幸中佐被判死刑。这是 1946 年 1 月至 1948 年 3 月间新加坡 131 场战犯审判之一。审判中日方提出的遇难人数约 5,000 人，远低于大多数估计。

summary.en: Where Japanese soldiers killed about 200 patients and staff on 14–15 February 1942, the day before the surrender.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 14 至 15 日，投降前一天，日军士兵在这里杀害了约 200 名病人和医护人员。

summary.en: Where Percival signed the surrender of Singapore on 15 February 1942; now a National Monument and museum.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 15 日白思华签字投降的地方；今天是国家古迹和展馆。

detail.en: The factory on Upper Bukit Timah Road had opened in October 1941 as Ford's first car assembly plant in Southeast Asia. Percival signed the unconditional surrender in its boardroom; during the occupation Nissan assembled military vehicles there.
detail.zh: 这座位于武吉知马路上段的工厂 1941 年 10 月投产，是福特在东南亚的第一座汽车装配厂。白思华在厂里的会议室签署无条件投降书；日据时期日产公司在这里组装军用车辆。

title.zh: 宪兵队东区分队（旧青年会大楼）

summary.en: The Japanese military police headquarters for eastern Singapore, where suspects were held and tortured, including after the Double Tenth.
summary.zh: 日本宪兵在新加坡东区的总部，嫌疑人被关押、拷打的地方，双十事件后也是如此。

detail.en: The Art Deco YMCA building on Stamford Road was run by Lieutenant-Colonel Oishi Masayuki, sentenced to death in 1947 for the Sook Ching, with about 200 regular Kempeitai and 1,000 auxiliaries. Elizabeth Choy and her husband were held here. The building was pulled down in 1981; a marker stands at the site.
detail.zh: 史丹福路上这座装饰艺术风格的青年会大楼，由大石正幸中佐指挥（1947 年他因肃清被判死刑）；手下有正规宪兵约 200 人、辅助宪兵 1,000 人。伊丽莎白·蔡和丈夫曾被关在这里。大楼于 1981 年拆除，原址立有史迹标志。

summary.en: Civilian internment camp from February 1942, when more than 2,500 civilians and POWs were packed into it; scene of the Double Tenth raid.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月起成为平民拘留营，2,500 多名平民和战俘被塞进这里；双十事件的发生地。

detail.en: European civilians were marched to Changi on 17 February 1942. Prisoners of war were held in the Changi area; some 87,000 passed through Changi during the war, and many were sent on to the Burma–Thailand Railway. The gate, part of the wall and two turrets of the 1936 prison survive as a National Monument.
detail.zh: 1942 年 2 月 17 日，欧洲平民被押往樟宜。战俘关在樟宜一带；战争期间约有 87,000 名战俘经过樟宜，许多人又被送去修泰缅铁路。这座 1936 年建成的监狱，大门、一段围墙和两座塔楼保留了下来，是国家古迹。

summary.en: On 20 February 1942, 66 Chinese men were shot at the water's edge here by auxiliary military police firing squads during the Sook Ching.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 20 日，66 名华人男子在这里的水边被辅助宪兵行刑队枪杀，这是肃清的一部分。

summary.en: On 28 February 1942 some 400 Chinese civilians, victims of the Sook Ching, were killed on this north-eastern shore.
summary.zh: 1942 年 2 月 28 日，约 400 名华人平民在这片东北海岸被杀，他们是肃清的受害者。

summary.en: Where Mountbatten accepted the surrender of Japanese forces in Southeast Asia on 12 September 1945.
summary.zh: 1945 年 9 月 12 日蒙巴顿在这里接受东南亚日军投降。

detail.en: In February 1942 the Japanese assembled European civilians and prisoners on the Padang in front of the building before marching them to Changi. After the war it was renamed City Hall (1951); Singapore's first elected cabinet was sworn in here in 1959, and the Proclamation of Malaysia was read from its steps on 16 September 1963.
detail.zh: 1942 年 2 月，日军把欧洲平民和战俘集中在大厦前的大草场，再押往樟宜。战后大厦于 1951 年改称市政厅；1959 年新加坡第一届民选内阁在这里宣誓就职，1963 年 9 月 16 日在大厦台阶上宣读了马来西亚成立宣言。
